A.explanation: Object of habituation (that abandoning/giving up) is left unstated, so what becomes habit is unclear.

B.explanation: "The time of the result" (འབྲས་བུའི་དུས) is dropped; only "他業及彼果" remains.

C.explanation: Adds first-person "I"; the Tibetan is an impersonal injunction.

A.span: 與其苦貪執，非我自主軀，何如趣涅槃？
A.explanation: Garbled comparative "與其...何如" scrambles the syntax; the rhetorical "why not go to nirvana" is obscured.

C.explanation: Clinging (ཡོངས་ཞེན) is dropped; only strong desire is rendered.

A.explanation: Concessive "even when covered" becomes a plain conditional "if covered".

B.span: 昔衣汝亦貪，今裸何不欲
B.explanation: Covered/uncovered are recast as past/present, a temporal sequence absent from the Tibetan.

C.explanation: "Fools" (གླེན་པ) rendered as "ordinary beings", losing the sense of foolishness.

B.explanation: "盡拖他" is unintelligible/mistyped; the sense "give oneself to others" (གཞན་ལ་གཏང་) is not conveyed.

C.explanation: The specific act of exchanging self and other is generalized to "benefiting beings".

B.explanation: Says "when you accept illusion"; the Tibetan says that illusion does not exist for you. "亦復非有" is left detached.

A.explanation: Makes the offerer's mind real/conventional; the Tibetan says the result holds whether (the Buddha) is conventional or ultimate.
"Contact/meeting" (ཕྲད་པ) rendered as "境遇" (circumstances); 接觸 is the standard term.

A.span: 父子相待有，如是無心境
A.explanation: Adds mutual dependence and replaces "those two" (father and son) with mind and object, not in the verse.

C.explanation: Unclear: "who craves and what is craved" compressed into a hard-to-parse phrase.

B.explanation: "There" (དེར, in that practice) rendered as "this life"; changes the referent.
Same "this life" error; also adds "正法" for the doubt.

C.explanation: "畏" is ambiguous; "may the frightened be fearless" is hard to parse as written.

B.explanation: Object of the wish changed from "whatever the protectors intend" to the protectors' compassionate care; "慈" added.
